thread:
maria (product): Morning — quick micro-check for milestone 'routing + canary': please post *shipped / slipped / blockers* + owner + next step. Keep it brief. CC @arjun @sam @jordan

arjun (eng-platform): Shipped to staging yesterday. Canary scheduled for tomorrow. Owner: arjun. Next: smoke tests + perf bench by EOD Tue. Blocker: infra quota for eu-west GPUs. @kevin any ETA? :eyes:

kevin (eng-infra): Quota request in with cloud — 48–72h response. I can carve 2 dev GPUs for a short canary window if we need to unblock earlier. Prefer to keep prod quota but can help.

sam (eng-runtime): Update: quantization pipeline PR hit a perf regression in kernel step, holding up variant v2. Owner: sam. Status: slipped. Blocker: regression root cause. Next: revert last change and rebench Wed. ETA end of week if we keep current approach. :grimacing:

jordan (eng-sre): Rollout plan is ready, oncall briefed. Auto-fallback to v1 is configured if tail latency > 300ms. Added alerting for high p95/p99. :thumbsup:

maria (product): Noted — big decision: revert vs patch. Revert unwraps features; patch delays canary. @sam if revert, do we lose anything customer-visible?

sam (eng-runtime): Revert removes an early prefix-caching tweak — no functional regressions for customers, just worse cost/throughput. I recommend revert to unblock canary quickly.

arjun (eng-platform): +1 for revert. I'll coordinate merge and canary trigger once kevin confirms GPU availability.

kevin (eng-infra): I can free up 2 GPUs in eu-west for a 6h canary window tomorrow. Ping me when PR merged.

maria (product): Action items: 1) Sam to open revert PR by 16:00 PST today. 2) Arjun to run perf smoke and ping Kevin once ready. 3) Jordan to monitor SLOs and dashboards. 4) Maria to update stakeholders if canary goes green. Any other deps?

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled canary window tomorrow 09:00–15:00 UTC. Please annotate runbook with test checklist. Deploy plan: https://redwood/internal/plans/route-canary

sam (eng-runtime): I'll post PR link here when it's up.

arjun (eng-platform): Also note config change needed in routing YAML, sending diff in PR: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: model-routing
    variant: v2
    fallback: v1
```

sam (eng-runtime): PR posted: https://git.redwood.co/pr/4823 — reverting patch, tests running.

jordan (eng-sre): Copy — I'll update runbook and add a temporary dashboard tile for the canary.

maria (product): Thanks all. We'll reconvene async after canary. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and me directly. :pray:
